question: Where was the first edition of the 2025 Kho Kho World Cup held in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi, India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first-ever Kho Kho World Cup** was hosted by **India** from **January 13 to January 19, 2025**.
 
• The primary venue for this historic sporting event was the **Indira Gandhi Arena** located in **New Delhi**.
 
• The tournament featured competition in both **men's and women's categories**, marking a global milestone for this indigenous Indian sport.
 
• Organized by the **Kho Kho Federation of India (KKFI)** in collaboration with the **International Kho Kho Federation**, the event saw participation from **24 nations** across six continents.
 
• The event was designed to showcase **Kho Kho**
